pages.rationale: Every region of frames 2/2b/2c is present and correct: toolbar, ribbon, anatomy card with marks legend and the 'rules resolved cleanly' chip, event readout, 10-thumbnail strip with jump-to-flagged, rose (F-03) swapped for the seeded overlay card (F-07), Rules with four controls and the flagged warning, the per-event table with the frame's exact columns, plus the stale veil, preview line, discard and Re-run. All three round-1 P1s are genuinely fixed. Deductions: F-07 shows 202 events / 3 flagged where canon and the frame say 212 / 9; the frame's amber onset-to-trough band is not drawn; the header omits the event count; the readout wraps to three lines and the rose card leaves a ragged column; the upstream=spike-shape placeholder keeps the slope rose and rules verbatim under a Spike shape title.

findings.title: prev fixed: 'units' now recomputes the whole page
findings.detail: ?units=mv-s moves the anatomy axis from -10 s..+20 s to -1 s..+2 s, the readout to duration 1.00 s / max slope -0.725 mV/s, and the rose caption to '-45 deg = -1 mV/s', with a units-note stating '1 plotted s = 10 s of recording (the frame convention)'. Nothing is left relabelled only.

findings.title: prev fixed: parameter controls lock while the run veil is up
findings.detail: ?state=running dims the card, shows '01 Resolve spans - 50 %', switches the primary to Cancel, and greys units, marks and all four rule controls.

findings.title: prev fixed: 'Re-run from 01' really runs
findings.detail: Clicking Re-run from 01 from ?state=stale raises a real veil ('Library family - 5 %'), a running badge on 01 in the ribbon and a Cancel primary before the stale badges clear.

findings.title: F-07 reads 202 events / 3 flagged where canon says 212 / 9
findings.detail: Frame 2b and spec section 0 give F-07 212 members: 'event 45 / 212', 'showing 41-50 of 212', '212 rows', 'jump to flagged (9)', '9 events flagged', overlay '10 of 212'. The page shows 202 everywhere and 3 flagged, because ten artifact members are dropped from scope. Internally consistent, but off the canon number the frame prints.

findings.title: The frame's amber onset-to-trough band is not drawn
findings.detail: Frame 2 shades the span between onset and trough amber behind the curve, which is what makes the chord and depth read as one measured region. The app draws only vertical rules plus the dashed chord on a plain ground. Builder-declared gap (the kit LineChart has no bands).

findings.title: Header omits the event count
findings.detail: Frame header: '01 Resolve spans | slope analysis | F-03 sharkfin | 16 events'. The app stops at 'F-03 sharkfin' (then the expected demo-data chip), so the run size is only visible further down the page.

findings.title: Readout wraps to three lines and the rose card under-fills its column
findings.detail: The frame keeps the readout on one line (depth, max slope, angle, peakedness); the app adds 'duration 10.0 s' and a units-note, pushing peakedness onto a second line and the note onto a third. The rose itself is small and its points cluster near the centre of the wedge, leaving the right card about 100 px shorter than the anatomy card, where the frame has the two flush.

findings.title: upstream=spike-shape relabels but reuses slope content
findings.detail: Title and ribbon become '01 Spike shape', but the body is the slope page verbatim: the rose is still 'Each fall as one angle', the rules are still onset / trough / steepest window / slope noise, and the readout still reads max slope and angle. Declared a placeholder in the fog file, but as drawn it claims to be a different algorithm.

findings.title: 'marks: all' is barely distinguishable and the control label doubles the word
findings.detail: ?marks=all adds only a faint dashed zero line over the default view; the dropdown then reads 'marks all marks'.

pages.rationale: All three histogram cards with a grey null behind and a verdict line, the scaling card with the pair segmented control, + custom, axes dropdown, exponent and null-beta tiles, the timeline with per-recording tau, the six-control Parameters card, the four summary tiles with CSV / Figures / Stage 1 outlier, the wiring popover and the empty and running states are present and live. Every round-1 P1 is fixed: colour-by keeps the null over the same bins, all six parameters recompute, wiring really rewires, F-04 refuses to fit, and ?state=running veils. Deductions are visual and copy: the inter-event card header overflows into an ellipsis and reports n 12 where the frame says n 15; max slope is teal where the frame is coral; the scaling fit has no 95 % CI ribbon and the legend no CI entry; the Parameters grid is 4+2 where the frame is 3+3 and the summary is 2x2 where the frame is 1x4; the page no longer fits 1440x900; the wiring popover anchors over the chain ribbon.

findings.title: prev fixed: colour-by keeps the null and the bins
findings.detail: ?colour=recording&pair=depth-maxslope now draws the grey null at full bin width behind the stacked per-recording bars on the same bins as default, with 'null' still first in the legend; the inter-event histogram keeps its seven bars instead of collapsing to one.

findings.title: prev fixed: F-04 no longer reports F-03's fit
findings.detail: ?family=F-04 now reads 'exponent beta - not fitted / 9 points - a power-law fit needs at least 12', every verdict line reads 'n 9 - too few to compare with the matched windows', the interval-CV tile reads 'too few', and an amber callout states the rule. The stray '02 Aggregate' string in the plot area is gone.

findings.title: prev fixed: the wiring selects rewire the page
findings.detail: ?wire=h3:peakedness,tl:duration_s turns the third card into 'Peakedness' with its own bins and the honest line 'wired to peakedness - no recorded verdict for this feature', and the timeline caption to 'height = duration_s'. The popover carries all seven slots, add scaling pair and reset.

findings.title: prev fixed: every Parameters control recomputes, null included
findings.detail: ?null=shuffled changes the toolbar chip to 'shuffled onsets', every legend to 'shuffled null', the verdicts to 'shuffled-onset CV 1.04 [0.78-1.31]' and the null beta tile to 0.28. ?outliers=excluded drops 3 points, recomputes beta to 1.81 [1.29-2.33] n 13 and adds an 'excluded from the fit' legend entry.

findings.title: prev fixed: ?state=running renders a running state
findings.detail: A veil over the cards with '02 Aggregate - 78 %', running badges on both chain blocks and a Cancel primary; the empty state's Run chain also starts a real run rather than jumping to results.

findings.title: Inter-event card header overflows into an ellipsis, and n is 12 not 15
findings.detail: The card title row reads 'Inter-event interval (i) h - n 12 - onset -> onset - median 0...' truncated mid-word at the card edge. Frame 3 reads 'Inter-event interval  h - n 15' and puts nothing else on that row; 16 events give 15 intervals in the frame's convention.

findings.title: The scaling fit has no 95 % CI ribbon
findings.detail: Frame 3 draws a pale blue confidence band around the fit line and the plot legend reads 'event / null / 95% CI'. The app draws a bare line and the legend reads 'event / matched windows / fit'. The CI numbers survive in the beta tile, so P10 is met, but the frame's band is missing.

findings.title: Max slope histogram is teal where the frame is coral
findings.detail: Frame 3 gives the three histograms blue / purple / coral-red. The app gives blue / purple / teal. Arguably safer under the colour semantics, but it is a visible departure from the frame.

findings.title: Parameters and summary grids differ from the frame, and the page no longer fits 1440x900
findings.detail: Frame: Parameters is 3 columns x 2 rows (colour by / null / binning, then interval / outliers / purity), the summary is one row of four tiles, and everything fits the 1440x900 frame. App: Parameters is 4 + 2, the summary is 2 x 2 in a narrower right column, and both sit below the fold - about 225 px of scroll are needed to reach them.

findings.title: Wiring popover anchors over the chain ribbon, not under '+ custom'
findings.detail: Frame 3c floats the Feature wiring panel over the scaling card, anchored below the '+ custom' control that opens it. The app floats it from the top of the content area, covering the 01 Spike shape ribbon tile and the whole Half-width histogram; the 'scaling pair 1' option is also truncated to 'half_width_s -> amplitude_...'.

findings.title: Run veil repeats its label per card and leaves the right column crisp
findings.detail: Each of the three histograms and the scaling card carries its own '02 Aggregate - 78 %' progress bar (four copies), while 'When events happened', both beta tiles and the summary stay fully drawn and undimmed, so the page reads half-busy, half-finished. The slope page uses a single veil.

findings.title: Null select truncates its own value
findings.detail: The Parameters 'null' select renders 'matched random windows - ...' with the 200x elided, where the frame prints 'matched random windows - 200x' in full.
